title: Sessions list: the IPv6 zero address renders raw (0000:0000:…:0000) and a token session with no user agent, IP or time renders as a row of dashes
body:
## Source

Walked on 2026-10-27 on Setup › 会话 (`/sys_session/view/all_sessions`, 18.2.0 runtime on a fresh dev database): three rows for Dev Admin — two browser sessions whose IP column reads `0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000` (the unspecified IPv6 address of a localhost connection, printed in full), and a third row with 「—」 in 用户代理, IP 地址 and 最后活动时间 (the dev-admin bearer session the console minted at login, which carries none of them).

## Target

1. The IP cell renders the unspecified / loopback addresses as 「本机」 (en: "this machine") with the raw value in the tooltip, and compresses other IPv6 addresses (`::1`, `2001:db8::1`).
2. A session without a user agent and IP is labelled by its kind (「API 令牌」 / 「开发管理员」) in the 用户代理 column instead of three dashes; the 最后活动时间 cell shows the created time when there is no later activity.
3. Both fixes live in the session object's field renderers or the `sys_session` list view, not in a page-specific hack; tests beside.

## File surface

The IP / user-agent cell renderers for `sys_session` in `ui/packages/app-shell` or `ui/packages/fields`, the `sys_session` object's view in `packages/platform-objects` if the labels come from metadata, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests for the three address forms and the token-session row; screenshot of the Sessions list on a dev instance.


<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-27 supplementary pass on objectstack main `f9867020c6` (the source console at :5180 against HotCRM 18.2.0, the maintainer's browser pane at 1149 × 507, zh-CN and en, dark and light). The maintainer asked, verbatim: 「补测的前 3 项立卡到 objectstack，只立不派。」— the first of the three (the Data pillar's 高级 dropdown) turned out to be the 2026-10-15 ruling B as designed (it flattens from a 1000 px content column), so two cards are filed.</sub>
